Turkey Cards (1 of 2)

Butterbean

Bourbon Red hen

draw Butterbean here

Knack: Busy Beak. +1 white die when you pull a Prank, and every success you roll on a Prank counts twice.

Quirk: Worrywart. +1 urge whenever another turkey is Spotted.

Quirk: Hiccups. At the end of every round, roll one red die: on a 6 you gobble (hic!).
